description: Create, validate, test and package standalone TinyWarden Python skills.
init: Create a working memory-availability starter, with captured-observation tests.
validate: Validate directory or ZIP metadata and schemas without executing skill code.
pack: Write a deterministic, validated upload ZIP; never overwrite an existing file.
test: Run captured-observation tests through the isolated SDK; no host access.
collect: Collect a real observation from this machine through the read-only broker.
new_directory: New package directory; must not exist.
id: Stable namespaced ID, for example acme/memory-pressure; tinywarden is reserved.
source: Package directory or ZIP. Use this tool for your own local authoring material.
new_output: New ZIP path outside the source directory; must not exist.
runtime: Verified SDK runtime directory; defaults to the SDK beside this tool.
cases: Format-1 JSON cases; defaults to tests.json inside the package.
approval: Explicitly approve all manifest capabilities for collection on this machine.
settings: Effective scalar settings JSON; defaults to the manifest defaults.
filesystem_helper: Existing trusted agent binary for filesystems.snapshot; no rebuild is needed.
observation_output: Optionally write observation JSON to a new file outside the package.
